classification.difficultyReason: Use converses of angle relationships to establish parallelism, including a derived angle and diagrams with no valid parallel pair.

content.prompt: This question reviews tests for two lines to be parallel. In each part, name all pairs of parallel lines, giving reasons.

spec.description: Z-shaped chain ABCD with no supplied parallel arrows.
spec.mathematics: Angles ABC and BCD are each 37 degrees.

answer.worked:
$$\angle ABC=\angle BCD=37^\circ$$
These alternate angles are equal, so $AB\parallel CD$.

spec.description: Collinear A, B, C; segments BE and CD descend right; no parallel arrows.
spec.mathematics: Angles ABE and ACD are each 50 degrees.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the two supplied angles are shown.

answer.worked:
$$\angle ABE=\angle ACD=50^\circ$$
These corresponding angles are equal, so $BE\parallel CD$.

spec.description: Vertical QR joins two rightward segments; right-angle squares at Q and R.
spec.mathematics: Angles PQR and QRS are right angles.

answer.worked:
$$\angle PQR+\angle QRS=90^\circ+90^\circ=180^\circ$$
The co-interior angles are supplementary, so $QP\parallel RS$.

spec.description: Two cross-lines AB and CD crossed by EF and GH; all three supplied angles retained without parallel arrows.
spec.mathematics: The two right-side interior angles on EF are 85 degrees each; the upper-left angle on GH at CD is 100 degrees.
spec.answerVisibility: No inferred angle or parallelism is shown.

answer.worked:
$$85^\circ+85^\circ=170^\circ\ne180^\circ$$
The co-interior angles show that $AB$ and $CD$ are not parallel.

$$85^\circ+100^\circ=185^\circ\ne180^\circ$$
The co-interior angles show that $EF$ and $GH$ are not parallel. Each remaining pair intersects in the diagram, so there are no parallel pairs.

spec.description: KLM collinear, NO lower left, OL diagonal and LP descending right.
spec.mathematics: Angle NOL is 130 degrees, OLP is 50 degrees and PLM is 80 degrees.
spec.answerVisibility: The angle needed for the parallelism test is not supplied.

answer.worked:
$$\angle OLM=50^\circ+80^\circ=130^\circ$$
Adjacent angles at $L$.

$$\angle NOL=\angle OLM=130^\circ$$
These alternate angles are equal, so $NO\parallel KM$.

spec.description: Quadrilateral ABCD with three supplied interior angles and no parallel markings.
spec.mathematics: A is 95 degrees, B is 80 degrees and D is 85 degrees.
spec.answerVisibility: Angle C and parallel relationships are not shown.

answer.worked:
$$\angle DAB+\angle ADC=95^\circ+85^\circ=180^\circ$$
These co-interior angles are supplementary, so $AB\parallel DC$.

$$\angle DAB+\angle ABC=95^\circ+80^\circ=175^\circ\ne180^\circ$$
Thus $AD$ and $BC$ are not parallel. The only parallel pair is $AB\parallel DC$.
